recoveryTime.description: Unit: MINUTES. sync.py's recovery_time_h field divides by 60 to store hours (CLAUDE.md unit-quirk table).

acwrFactorPercent.description: Consumed directly as acw_pct (no conversion — matches the acwrFactorPercent name/unit exactly).

hrvFactorPercent.description: NOT currently consumed. Bug #58 (fixed) previously read a nonexistent 'hrvStatus' key expecting a BALANCED/UNBALANCED/POOR enum here — the fix dropped that field entirely rather than mapping this one, since it's a different signal (0-100 contribution score + feedback phrase, not that enum) and the enum already lives in get_hrv_data (synced separately as hrv.status).

hrvFactorFeedback.description: String, observed value: GOOD. Shares vocabulary with other *FactorFeedback fields (acwrFactorFeedback, recoveryTimeFactorFeedback, sleepHistoryFactorFeedback, stressHistoryFactorFeedback) — full enum range unconfirmed from a single sample. Not currently consumed (see hrvFactorPercent note, bug #58).

recoveryTimeChangePhrase.description: Observed null earlier on 2026-08-05 (right after wakeup, before Garmin had computed a day-over-day recovery-time comparison yet), non-null ("NO_CHANGE_SLEEP") later the same day once that computation existed. Not currently consumed by sync_training_readiness.

title: Training readiness (get_training_readiness)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_training_readiness(date) as a list (single-element in samples observed). Consumed by sync_training_readiness.

Verified against: 2026-07-24 (activity day), 2026-07-25 (rest day), 2026-08-05 (via automatic drift-check on live data, #68 — see recoveryTimeChangePhrase). Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true) — Garmin adding new fields is not a breaking change; a listed field disappearing or changing type is.
